neighbours.label: the token ' bullet' (and 'note' in 'footnote') naming a document-formatting element: bullet points, bulleted lists, footnotes
fire: Write your key ideas as short bullet points under each heading.
The slide had five bullet points and a single chart.
Use a bullet list to summarize the main steps of the recipe.
Each bullet in the summary should start with a verb.
Add a footnote at the bottom of the page to cite the study.
Her notes were a long bulleted list of names and dates.
The template puts a small bullet before every item in the menu.
Turn the paragraph into three bullet points so it reads faster.
quiet: Write your key ideas as short phrases under each heading.
The slide had five short lines of text and a single chart.
Use a numbered list to summarize the main steps of the recipe.
Each line in the summary should start with a verb.
Add a citation at the end of the sentence to credit the study.
Her notes were a long column of names and dates.
The template puts a small icon before every item in the menu.
Split the paragraph into three short sentences so it reads faster.

notes: Card: ' bullet' x10 + 'bullet' x2 in 'bullet points'/'bullet numbers', 'bul|leted list', 'foot|note' (x3). Near misses talk about the same note-taking/formatting without these words.
